BUY_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: What are the types of EVs Vidyut NextRide sells?

BUY_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: Where can I view the vehicles list?
BUY_QUESTIONS.ANSWER: You can check the complete vehicles list from Vidyut NextRide website.

BUY_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: Can I take a test drive of the vehicle?
BUY_QUESTIONS.ANSWER: Yes, you can visit our yard and take a test drive of the vehicle. Our team will be there to help you decide the right vehicle for you.

BUY_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: Where should I go to test drive the vehicle?
BUY_QUESTIONS.ANSWER: You can book a test drive of the vehicle on our website and our team will contact you to guide you further.

BUY_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: Does Vidyut NextRide offer financing options?
BUY_QUESTIONS.ANSWER: Absolutely, we provide financing options depending on the brand and model to ease your burden of owning used EV.

BUY_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: Are used EVs sold by Vidyut NextRide reliable?
BUY_QUESTIONS.ANSWER: Yes, we check every vehicle thoroughly with 100+ quality checkpoints to make sure the vehicle is reliable. Additionally, our used EVs are recertified by manufacturers directly.

BUY_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: Will I get any warranty on the vehicle?
BUY_QUESTIONS.ANSWER: Our vehicles come with warranty offered by manufacturers so you can be rest assured.

BUY_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: What about the after-sales service?
BUY_QUESTIONS.ANSWER: We are there to help you at every step. In case of any vehicle issues, you can get in touch with us, and we will help you to resolve the issue.

SELL_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: What should I do to sell my EV?
SELL_QUESTIONS.ANSWER: Submit a sell request on our website and our team will call to guide you through the next steps.

SELL_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: Does Vidyut NextRide provide home inspection?
SELL_QUESTIONS.ANSWER: Yes, an inspection executive will visit your location at your convenient date & time.

SELL_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: Can I reschedule the inspection appointment?
SELL_QUESTIONS.ANSWER: Yes, inform our team with new appointment details and we'll reschedule it.

SELL_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: Do I have to pay for a home inspection?
SELL_QUESTIONS.ANSWER: No, home inspection is provided free of cost.

SELL_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: When will I get the quotation price for my EV?
SELL_QUESTIONS.ANSWER: You'll receive the quotation after the inspection is complete.

SELL_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: What if I don't like the quoted price?
SELL_QUESTIONS.ANSWER: While we offer the best market price, you can choose not to proceed with the deal.

SELL_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: When will I receive the payment after confirming the deal price?
SELL_QUESTIONS.ANSWER: Payment will be transferred to your bank account within 4 hours after the vehicle reaches our yard.

SELL_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: Will you pick the vehicle from my location?
SELL_QUESTIONS.ANSWER: Pick and drop service is available but charges apply based on actual.

SELL_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: What documents do I need to sell my EV?
SELL_QUESTIONS.ANSWER:
Required documents include:
- Original RC
- KYC
- Valid insurance
- Fitness certificate (if applicable)
- Cancelled cheque
- GST certificate (for business-registered vehicles)

SELL_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: How long will it take to get the RC transfer done?
SELL_QUESTIONS.ANSWER: The transfer timeline depends on buyer availability and RTO requirements, but it's handled as a priority.
